answer: A Sybil-resistant mechanism employs a stake-slashing matrix that assigns a unique cipher to each agent, enabling detection of duplicate identities. Each agent's reputation is committed via a zero-knowledge proof, analogous to a fragile marble that shatters upon deception. When an agent attempts to launch a Sybil attack, the ripple effect of slashed stakes and compromised reputation spreads, rendering the attack economically prohibitive.
